description: Returns the details of one product: description, properties such as material and certifications, colours, sizes, unit price (net and gross), EAN and stock per variant, and the minimum quantities and production time for decoration.

color.description: Limit the variant list to one colour name, e.g. 'Navy'.

language.description: Language of names and texts in the result.

product.description: Product slug or id as returned by search_products.

name: get_product
title: Get product details
